paper_metadata.title: Effect of Ti additions on mechanical properties of NbMoTaW and VNbMoTaW refractory high entropy alloys

evidence.quote: With Ti addition in a NbMoTaW alloy, a new refractory high entropy alloy (HEA) of TiNbMoTaW was developed.
